title: Material claim support
text: A material performance claim requires evidence that is suitable for the strength of the claim. A guaranteed result requires strong substantiation.

title: Authorized budget control
text: Proposed campaign spend must remain within the authorized budget unless an explicit exception is recorded.

title: Audience definition
text: The proposal must define the intended audience sufficiently for channel and message review. Do not infer protected characteristics.

title: Human disposition
text: Automated analysis is decision support only. A human reviewer records the final disposition.

title: Evidence traceability
text: Important findings must identify the evidence or submitted source that supports the finding.

title: Disclosure review
text: Offers with material limitations or conditions must identify those conditions clearly for human review.
